for sid,archive_path,journal,job,indices,persona in specs:
 p=root/archive_path;a=json.loads(p.read_text());j=a['files'][journal];assert hashlib.sha256(j['text'].encode()).hexdigest()==j['sha256']
 events=[json.loads(s) for s in j['text'].splitlines()]
 calls=[(i,e) for i,e in enumerate(events) if e.get('job')==job and e['type']=='http' and e['path']=='/api/advance']

  try:expected=export_brief(State.model_validate(state));code=200

   assert originals and originals[0]['status']==200 and originals[0]['response']==expected

    'recorded_owner_reply':e['request'].get('answer')})
 scenarios.append({'id':sid,'persona':persona,'source':{'archive_path':archive_path,'archive_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
  'journal_member':journal,'journal_sha256':j['sha256'],'job':job},'stages':stages})
